title: lowRISC Sonata system (CHERIoT-Ibex SoC)
_note: lowRISC's Sonata: the CHERIoT-Ibex SoC -- the system top and its pinmux, the
TL-UL crossbar, and the peripheral set (GPIO, UART, SPI, I2C, PWM, timers,
the HyperRAM controller, the USB device and the display drivers), over
vendored Ibex, the lowRISC prim / prim_generic / tlul libraries and the
CHERIoT debug module.  Only sonata-system's own rtl/ is swept; the vendored
trees are closure-only (OpenTitan's prim and tlul have their own families).
No generation step is needed, and that was CHECKED rather than assumed:
rtl/templates holds Mako templates for pinmux.sv, sonata_pkg.sv and
sonata_xbar_main.sv, but all three OUTPUTS are committed (rtl/system/ and
rtl/bus/), so FuseSoC never has to run.  core-v-mcu.json records the same
check; cv32e40x shows what assuming it costs.
THREE rows are excluded because they need things this repository does not
contain, which is the class SERV excludes its board tops for:
sonata_system (the SoC top) and dm_top instantiate the Xilinx JTAG primitive
`BSCANE2` and the GENERATED debug ROMs (`debug_rom_ch`, `debug_rom_rv`, from
OpenTitan / CHERIoT ipgen), and xadc instantiates the Xilinx XADC macro.
Two closure facts that cost a measurement each, both found from a failing
row's own log:
* the prim packages are in a NESTED vendor tree --
vendor/lowrisc_ibex/vendor/lowrisc_ip/ip/prim -- not the top-level
vendor/lowrisc_ip, which holds only i2c / tlul / top_pkg / uart / usbdev.
Pointing at the wrong one left 8 rows short of their prim_util_pkg and
prim_mubi_pkg.  prim_xilinx sits beside prim_generic there, so it is
excluded for the duplicate-flavour reason tech_cells_generic.json and
core-v-mcu.json both record.
* `prim_flop` has no concrete definition in the RTL at all: the only one is
vendor/lowrisc_ibex/dv/uvm/core_ibex/common/prim/prim_flop.sv, so the
`/dv/` source exclusion has to spare exactly that directory, and
open_hbmc (hbmc_ctrl.v) is its own vendor root.
First local survey 2026-10-29: 37 rows, 36 / 37 elaborate, every elaborating
row with 0 undriven.  ONE open reader lead: `gpio` aborts the reader with
`Assert 'offset >= 0' failed`, and `xbar_main` aborted the same way with
`Assert 'length >= 0'` before the nested-prim fix -- both downstream of
`Unhandled system function call: $clog2`, which leaves a parameter at 0 so a
`[W-1:0]` range becomes the degenerate `[-1:0]` and the geometry goes
negative.  The formal and co-sim columns come from the first nightly.
